question: Across deterministic generated rules, does the served static profile preserve raw piece-value ratios and ordering after median normalization, integer rounding, and [1, MAX_STATIC_EVAL] clipping, and how coarse are the normalized values?

endpoint.primary: For each rule, count ceiling clips (normalized==MAX_STATIC_EVAL), floor clips (normalized==1), raw-order inversions, and distinct-raw tie groups after rounding.
endpoint.material_tie: a tie group whose largest/smallest raw ratio is >=1.10
endpoint.ratio_distortion: for type pairs with raw ratio>=1.05, |normalized_ratio/raw_ratio-1|
endpoint.cross_rule_raw: for movement signatures occurring in more than one rule, exact raw-score equality
endpoint.promotion_gain: promotion_gain equals max target board value minus source board value

decision_rule_written_before_run: If any raw-order inversion or ceiling clip occurs, record defect_detected. Else if >=10% of the 40 rules contain a material tie, record coarse_normalization_supported. Else record ratio_rounding_bounded. Record all counts either way; do not retune seeds or thresholds.
consumer: rule-only generic prices and cross-game ratios: whether normalized board values can be used as ratio evidence at the observed resolution, or whether raw capability scores must accompany them.
nonclaims: no search strength or game-outcome claim
no human or external price fit
single generator family and one fixed seed block
